The '''Berrun system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="Atlas" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Berrun]].<ref name="Jedi" /> Berrun was host to a [[Berrun detention center|Republic detention center]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]],<ref name="The Surgeons">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Sergeant Rusk|The Surgeons}}</ref> and the system hosted the [[Galactic Games/Legends|Galactic Games]] sporting event in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].<ref name="Jedi" />

==Behind the scenes==
Berrun was first mentioned in [[Jude Watson]]'s young reader novel ''[[Jedi Quest: The Dangerous Games]]'', published in [[2002]], but no information on the planet's placement was given in the book.<ref name="Jedi" /> It was not until [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' identified the Berrun system as being located in the Colonies that the planet was given a location.<ref name="Atlas" />
